name: Выхухоль
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon Russian DESMAN (vyhuhol) character, long flexible trunk-snout, tiny eyes, webbed pink feet, sleek waterproof brown fur, brave curious face.
world: deep-water exploration — free-diving, brass diving helmets, bathyscaphes, sunken ruins and bioluminescence
tone: cool deep-ocean blues and teal with warm gold glows — a dark, luminous underwater tone
scenes: a desman pup in a homemade shell diving-mask peeking over a quiet pond edge, curious, three-quarter view.
a young diver holding a handheld lantern with a satchel of finds, wading into the shallows, side view.
an explorer in a riveted brass diving helmet drifting among drifting jellyfish, low upward camera angle.
a bathyscaphe captain framed inside a round porthole, deep water with ruined coral towers beyond the glass.
a pioneer of the abyss riding a great manta ray down a dark ocean trench, dynamic diagonal composition.
the desman as a colossal LEVIATHAN-guardian of the deep, coiling over a sunken golden city, godrays through the water, NO wings.

name: Сойка
ident: A cute but COOL cartoon EURASIAN JAY character, pinkish-brown body, a bright blue-barred wing patch, a black moustache stripe, clever curious eyes.
world: art and shiny-treasure — a jay that hoards glass beads, paints, and curates a gallery
tone: bright airy daylight with soft rainbow stained-glass pastels — a light, luminous gallery tone
scenes: a young jay tilting its head to pick up a shiny glass bead in its beak, delighted, on a sunlit branch.
a collector with a satchel of glittering trinkets and a paintbrush tucked behind an ear-feather, a cozy nook.
a stained-glass artist arranging floating glass shards into a picture, daylight streaming through them.
a gallery curator presenting a levitating masterpiece frame in a bright airy hall, a soft spotlight.
a master painter sweeping a giant luminous mural across the sky with broad wing-strokes.
the jay as a radiant SPIRIT-GALLERIST, wings a mosaic of stained-glass light, holding a golden brush, floating in a cathedral of glass.
